name: How can I prepare my home for a second-story addition?
description: Prepare your home by decluttering, safeguarding valuables, and ensuring clear access for construction. Discuss utility plans with your contractor.

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my home for a second-story addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing your home involves decluttering spaces, safeguarding valuables, and potentially arranging for temporary storage or relocation of sensitive items from the upper floor. It's also wise to discuss utility shut-off schedules and temporary access routes with your contractor. A crucial preparation step is to ensure clear access around your property for construction vehicles and material delivery.
